title: Holiday Ad Photos and Videos for Gift Season | AIVideosUGC
description: Make holiday ad photos and videos from one product photo. Add confirmed dates, prices or offers after download, then reuse the scene as campaigns change.
h1: Create Holiday Ad Photos and Videos Fast
lead: Paste a product link and get holiday ad photos and videos with a script, an actor, and a voiceover, then type the shipping date yourself.

faq.q: How many credits does a holiday photo or video use?
faq.a: A photo uses 24 credits. Video uses 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. The cost shows before you start, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Can I add a voiceover, music, and captions to the holiday clip?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI voice, a track from the music library, and automatic captions in the built-in editor. Use a track you have the rights to play.

faq.q: Can I make holiday scenes for a whole catalog at once?
faq.a: Yes. Batch mode runs a set of product links and returns one gift scene each. You still review every file before it is published.

faq.q: Can the gift message use an actor from the library?
faq.a: Yes. Pick one, describe a festive look, or build one from a short clip of you. People in the scene are generated. They are not real customers, real celebrities, or people you hired.

faq.q: What happens to the visual after the holiday ends?
faq.a: You keep the file you downloaded. Change the date, the voiceover, or the offer in the editor and reuse the scene for the next seasonal push.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page and the photos and details come in as a storyboard. You can also upload the clear photo you already sell with.

faq.q: Can I publish to TikTok or Meta from here?
faq.a: Yes. Publish in one click to TikTok, Instagram, or Meta, or download the file. It stays in your account until you share it, and the download has no AIVideosUGC watermark.

faq.q: Can my store request holiday ads through an API?
faq.a: Yes. The API lets your store ask for a holiday ad from a product link. You approve the file before anyone else sees it.

faq.q: What frame should the holiday video use?
faq.a: A product photo is square. A clip of that scene can run 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds in 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Each video is its own job.

faq.q: How do I put an order-by date on the ad?
faq.a: Type it in the built-in editor. Keeping the date editable lets you change it as the cutoff gets closer, without rebuilding the gift scene.

faq.q: Can the same script be spoken in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Pick another language for the voiceover so shoppers who are not local hear the gift message in their language.

faq.q: Can I make Mother's Day product ads the same way?
faq.a: Yes. Describe a Mother's Day table or gift scene instead of a winter one, and add that occasion's date after you confirm it.

reviews.h2: How shops build gift guide product images
reviews.lead: Three ways a shop gets the gift scene up before the cutoff is confirmed.

items.t: Have an actor lift the set
items.d: They paste the gift-set page and ask an actor to lift it from the box. The order-by line is typed later, so a moved cutoff does not force a new scene.

items.t: Stand a generated actor by the coat
items.d: They keep the coat's color and shape, with an actor next to an open gift. That actor is generated, not a hired customer.

items.t: Keep the candle, change the voice
items.d: They download the candle-and-ribbon scene once. Next weekend they only change the voiceover language and the offer line.
